Warning signs of a threshold, by species

Source: R/warning_signs.R
warning_signs.Rd

Gathers, for each species, the warning signs that the detections left after a threshold are not a reliable input for an ecological model, and gives a verdict. The signs follow the threshold workflow (Larissa S. M. Sugai, ACAD pilot); this function computes those that a review sample can show:

Usage

warning_signs(
  validation,
  thresholds,
  groups = NULL,
  curves = NULL,
  recall = NULL,
  target_precision = 0.95,
  min_n = 15,
  min_tp_kept = 0.25,
  max_fp_spread = 0.3,
  min_ceiling = 0.5,
  threshold_column = "threshold",
  file = NULL
)

Arguments

validation

Reviewed clips, as for suggest_thresholds().

thresholds

The threshold of each species or cell: a single number, or a table with species_folder (and optionally site) and a threshold column, such as the output of suggest_thresholds() (threshold_column picks another column, such as "threshold_conservative" of threshold_bootstrap()).

groups

Columns of validation for signs 6 and 7, such as "site" or a month column. NULL uses "site" when there is more than one site.

curves

Optional output of compare_calibration_curves() (sign 8). With curves fitted by site, the worst verdict of the species counts.

recall

Optional output of recall_ceiling() (sign 1). With a ceiling per site, the lowest counts.

target_precision

Target precision of the threshold (sign 7).

min_n

Minimum number of clips of a group for it to count in signs 6 and 7.

min_tp_kept

Sign 2 is raised when the share of the true positives kept by the threshold is below this.

max_fp_spread

Sign 6 is raised when the false-positive rate of two levels of a group differs by more than this.

min_ceiling

Sign 1 is raised when the recall ceiling is below this.

threshold_column

Column of thresholds with the threshold.

file

Optional path of a Markdown file to write the report to.

Value

A tibble with one row per species: species_folder, threshold (the median over its cells), sign1_ceiling, sign1, sign2_tp_kept, sign2, sign6_fp_spread, sign6, sign6_detail, sign7_share_below, sign7, sign7_detail, sign8_verdict, sign8, n_checked, n_raised and verdict. The signN columns are TRUE (raised), FALSE (clear) or NA (not checked).

Details

signwhat it saysfrom
1low recall ceiling: in many occasions with the species, the classifier gave it no score at allrecall, the output of recall_ceiling() (needs "random_recordings" occasions annotated by ear)
2the threshold discards most true positivesthe reviewed clips: share of the positive clips at or above the threshold, weighted by 1 / inclusion_prob
6false positives vary by site or seasonthe reviewed clips: range of the false-positive rate among the levels of each groups column; the most frequent identity of the negative clips, when validation has identity
7the threshold is not stable across groupsthreshold_by_group() for each groups column
8the logistic curve is wrong near the thresholdcurves, the output of compare_calibration_curves()

Signs 3, 4 and 5 (occupied sites lost, detected days that do not track the true activity, false negatives that vary by site) need site-days whose true activity is known, that is recordings annotated in full, and are not computed here. A sign whose input is missing is NA, not FALSE: it was not checked.

Verdict. A heuristic summary, not a test:

  • "not_trustworthy": the species has no threshold (no score reaches the target), no calibration curve reaches the target (sign 8), or three or more signs are raised;

  • "use_with_caveats": one or two signs are raised;

  • "trustworthy_with_care": every sign checked is clear. The signs not checked (n_checked < 5) and signs 3 to 5 may still be raised;

  • "not_assessed": no sign could be checked.

Which clips. Signs 2 and 6 are rates of the predictions, so they use the clips with an inclusion probability ("random_detections", "score_bands", "directed_pps"), weighted by 1 / inclusion_prob. Without any such clip they use every reviewed clip, unweighted, with a message: clips of "top" are not a random sample, and the rates are then only indicative.

See also

recall_ceiling(), compare_calibration_curves(), threshold_by_group(), threshold_record(), confuser_summary().

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
thr <- suggest_thresholds(val, target_precision = 0.95, sustained = TRUE)
warning_signs(val, thr, groups = c("site", "month"),
              curves = compare_calibration_curves(val),
              recall = recall_ceiling(rr, det, thresholds = thr,
                                      by = c("site", "species_folder")),
              file = "warning_signs.md")
} # }
